description.value: Sandman Hotel Vancouver City Centre is a downtown Vancouver hotel located on West Georgia Street in the city's business district. It is part of the Sandman Hotels chain and provides standard accommodation for travelers. Cycling tourists should contact the hotel directly to inquire about bike storage and touring-specific amenities.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 17m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; bollard (2 spaces) at 27m; bollard (2 spaces) at 44m; bollard (2 spaces) at 61m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m; bollard (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 16 spaces.
